summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Dalpin Heritage NIS2 landing page. 9/9 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend renders all sections, lead capture flow works end-to-end (success state visible), Priority modal opens and submits, FAQ accordion expands, anchor nav scrolls, mobile menu toggles. Email graceful degradation works as expected (domain unverified -> email_sent=false but lead is saved).

issues: Success state in PriorityModal (when done=true, 'Candidatura recebida.' block) has no data-testid, making it untestable. Recommend adding data-testid='priority-success' on the success div (line 76 of PriorityModal.jsx).

Mobile menu drawer that opens on toggle has no data-testid (e.g., 'mobile-menu') on the wrapper div at line 77 of Header.jsx. Functionality works (6 anchor links visible after toggle) but no stable selector.

action_items: Add data-testid='priority-success' to PriorityModal success state (line 76) for testability.
Add data-testid='mobile-menu' to mobile menu drawer wrapper in Header.jsx (line 77).

Naming inconsistency vs. review request: review_request specified 'priority-form-email/company/submit' and 'lead-form-success' but implementation uses 'priority-email/company/submit' and 'capture-success'. Functional flows verified to work; align naming if external test harness expects the spec names.

Reminder: Verify dalpinheritage.com domain on Resend so email_sent becomes true in production. Currently emails fail with: 'The dalpinheritage.com domain is not verified...' — graceful degradation is functioning correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/leads is synchronous on the email send path (await asyncio.to_thread on resend.Emails.send). Each lead submission blocks ~500ms-2s waiting for Resend. Consider making email send fire-and-forget via BackgroundTasks so the API responds faster and is resilient to Resend latency/outages.

list_leads converts created_at strings back to datetime objects in a Python loop after the Mongo query. Either store as native datetime in Mongo (preferred) or skip the conversion since pydantic Lead.created_at can accept ISO strings.

Lead model includes email_sent and email_error in GET /api/leads response — exposing internal email-delivery details on a publicly reachable endpoint is a minor info leak. Consider auth-protecting GET /api/leads or using a slimmer public response schema.
GET /api/leads is unauthenticated and returns up to 500 leads (including emails) — this is a data-exposure risk. Should require admin auth.
PriorityModal does not reset 'done' state when modal is closed/reopened; user opening modal again sees the success screen until page reload.
seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_-prefixed leads and waitlist entries against real MongoDB during pytest runs; all visible via GET /api/leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (pytest, 9 tests, all passing). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Resend domain 'dalpinheritage.com' is intentionally unverified — email_sent will be false until user verifies; do not flag as bug. Frontend testids: lead-form-{name,email,role,submit}, capture-success (NOT lead-form-success), priority-{email,company,submit} (NOT priority-form-*), priority-modal, priority-modal-close, faq-item-{0..5}, nav-link-{label}, header-priority-cta, hero-secondary-cta, mobile-menu-toggle.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Naming mismatches between review_request spec and actual implementation noted under action_items.
